system.boundary: Build an end-to-end coherent two-target FMCW radar model containing chirp generation, target propagation and echoes, a dechirped complex-baseband receiver, and range-Doppler detection.
engineering_objects: P9-XCOMM01 plant and controller described by the current public task contract
Measured output interfaces: beat_signal, detections, receiver_status
physical_paths: Across the declared range, detect both targets, estimate their ranges and signed radial velocities, remain ordered by range, suppress clutter and false alarms, and maintain or reacquire reliable detections through the temporary interferer.
functional_paths: Across the declared range, detect both targets, estimate their ranges and signed radial velocities, remain ordered by range, suppress clutter and false alarms, and maintain or reacquire reliable detections through the temporary interferer.

detections must contain [near-target range in m, near-target radial velocity in m/s, near confidence, far-target range in m, far-target radial velocity in m/s, far confidence], ordered by estimated range.
receiver_status must contain [receiver lock, false-alarm indicator, interference-present estimate].
